comment: display.c newsym() takes its map_invisible() arm for a visible square remembered as an unseen monster, without _map_location(), so dungeon.c update_lastseentyp() does not run there. The blindfolded hero teleports into an unvisited room and an invisible newt attacks, leaving an 'I' on a square never seen; after the blindfold comes off, #terrain (detect.c reveal_terrain_getglyph()) draws that square from lastseentyp as stone. Variation: unseen-invisible-marker-keeps-last-seen-type-seen-first.
